In [5]:
#standardize each data frame

scaler_train = StandardScaler()
scaler_cleveland = StandardScaler()
scaler_framingham = StandardScaler()

x_train_scaled = scaler_train.fit_transform(x_train)
x_cleveland_scaled = scaler_cleveland.fit_transform(x_cleveland)
x_framingham_scaled = scaler_framingham.fit_transform(x_framingham)

x_train_scaled = pd.DataFrame(x_train_scaled, columns=x_train.columns)
x_cleveland_scaled = pd.DataFrame(x_cleveland_scaled, columns=x_cleveland.columns)
x_framingham_scaled = pd.DataFrame(x_framingham_scaled, columns=x_framingham.columns)
In [7]:
# find best k value for each using elbow, then silhouette
# elbow and silouhette for nhanes scaled

#elbow
inertias_train = []
K = range(1, 11)

for k in K:
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters = k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    kmeans.fit(x_train_scaled)
    inertias_train.append(kmeans.inertia_)
#elbow plot for nhanes
plt.plot(K, inertias_train, marker='o')
plt.title('Elbow Method for Cardio Train Dataset')
plt.xlabel('Number of clusters (k)')
plt.ylabel('Inertia')
plt.show()

#silhouette

K = range(2, 11)
scores_train = []

for k in K:
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters = k, random_state = 42, n_init = 10)
    train_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(x_train_scaled)
    score = silhouette_score(x_train_scaled, train_labels)
    scores_train.append(score)

plt.plot(K, scores_train, marker='o')
plt.title("Silhouette Score vs K for Cardio Train Dataset")
plt.xlabel("Number of clusters (k)")
plt.ylabel("Silhouette Score")
plt.show()

In [8]:
# Framingham: KMeans for k = 1 to 7
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 7, figsize=(28, 4))
for ax, k in zip(axes, range(1, 8)):
    labels = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10).fit_predict(x_framingham_scaled)
    ax.scatter(x_framingham['sysBP'], x_framingham['BMI'], c=labels, cmap='coolwarm', s=6)
    ax.set_title(f"k={k}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Systolic BP (mmHg)")
    ax.set_ylabel("BMI (kg/m²)")
fig.suptitle("Framingham KMeans")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

In [6]:
#initialize model for nhanes dataset - examie 3 different k values

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4))
for ax, (name, x_scaled, k) in zip(axes, [
    ("Train", x_train_scaled, 2),
    ("Cleveland",   x_cleveland_scaled,   2),
    ("Framingham",    x_framingham_scaled,    2),
]):
    labels = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10).fit_predict(x_scaled)
    dim = PCA(n_components=2).fit_transform(x_scaled)
    ax.scatter(dim[:, 0], dim[:, 1], c=labels, cmap='coolwarm', s=6)
    ax.set_title(f"{name} (k={k})")
    ax.set_xlabel("PC1"); ax.set_ylabel("PC2")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("PC Variance for x_train_scaled:")

pca = PCA(n_components=2).fit(x_train_scaled)
loadings = pd.DataFrame(pca.components_.T, index=x_train.columns, columns=['PC1','PC2'])
print(loadings.round(2))
print(pca.explained_variance_ratio_.round(2))   # how much variance each axis captures

train_labels = kmeans_train.fit_predict(x_train_scaled)

train_df['cluster'] = train_labels
print(train_df['cluster'].value_counts())

profile = train_df.groupby('cluster')[x_train.columns].mean()
print(profile.round(1))
